highlights.title: Every screen in kwant's own colours
highlights.text: The older greens and purples are gone, so every screen uses kwant's teal and lavender, and buttons stay easy to read when you point at them.

highlights.title: Ollama bots come back on their own
highlights.text: If Ollama starts after kwant does, your Ollama bots now work within about 15 seconds or at your next message. If it's still off, the chat says where kwant looked.
